name: ADR-01 Jeri
main_effect:
[On Play] For each digivolution card of 1 of your [Mother D-Reaper]s, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -1000 for the turn.
[Main] Place this Digimon as the bottom digivolution card of 1 of your [Mother D-Reaper] without [ADR-01 Jeri] in its digivolution cards.
source_effect: [Opponent's Turn] When any of your opponent's Digimon attack, you may play 1 [ADR-01 Jeri] from this Digimon's digivolution cards without paying the cost. If you played, you may change the attack target to the Digimon played by this effect.
